hooks.logic:
Count up "turnInCurrState".
Let v6 be the count "turnInCurrState".
Let aiArg be the battle settings of the enemy.
Run helper.
If condition flag v5 is up this frame, then increase the register's 'turnCountForMagicalGun' by one.
If condition flag v4 is up this frame, then
  Let v7 be run helper2.
  Run helper3 on v7.
Let part be part 1 of the enemy.
If part is ready to act, then
  Let data3 be {turn: the numeric entry "turns_of_first_calling_security" in aiArg, intervalTurn: the numeric entry "turns_of_calling_security" in aiArg}.
  If the register's 'turnCountForMagicalGun' is at least the numeric entry "turns_of_magical_gun" in aiArg, then part uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: "01"}], [{builtin: "RESET", resetChildNos: [1]}]]} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true} and stop.
  If the id of the move labelled "magical_gun" on part is a smart-weighted move of part, then part uses the move labelled "magical_gun" and stop.
  If call game:ai.AiUtil.checkTurnForceAbilityConf with (v6, data3), then
    If the length of run helper2 is more than 0, then part uses the move labelled "security_guard" and stop.
  Part picks and uses a smart-weighted move.

script_hooks.logic:
Let part be part 1 of the enemy.
Let paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs be the form for part under the phases list4.
If paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs is not the current form of part, then
  Part changes to form paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs.
  Part cancels its cast.

flow.text: Let part be part 1 of the enemy.
Let paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs be the form for part under the phases list4.
paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs is not the current form of part

script_hooks.logic: Return the items x in list3 where not (part x of the enemy is not dead or not the register's 'isReadyForRevivedSecurity' at x or list contains x and (set the register's 'isReadyForRevivedSecurity' at x to false, then set the register's 'isReadyForRevivedSecurity' at (data at x) to true, then 1)).

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Part 1 of the acting enemy uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: a revive sequence {deformTag: "deformation_01", nos: arg, filteringDeformPosArray: arg, shouldReset: true}} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.

flow.text: Part 1 of the acting enemy uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: a revive sequence {deformTag: "deformation_01", nos: arg, filteringDeformPosArray: arg, shouldReset: true}} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.

helpers.name: list5
helpers.logic: [call game:ai.StateSnippet.CountupWithGlobalRegister.getConditionFlagHash with (1), {conditionFlagTag: v4, condition: {class: "AbilityCountTransitCondition", args: {abilityTag: "security_guard", id: 1, whenDone: true, count: 1}}}, {conditionFlagTag: v5, condition: {class: "AbilityCountTransitCondition", args: {abilityTag: "magical_gun", id: 1, whenDone: true, count: 1}}}]
For each x in list, set data2's 'isReadyForRevivedSecurity' at x to true.
For each x in list2, set data2's 'isReadyForRevivedSecurity' at x to false.
